messages:
emma: Heads up — saw a spike of reconnect loops from eu-west-1 clients around 09:12 UTC. Root cause looks like idle close from the proxy + immediate priority-based route swap.

raj: any logs? what's 'priority-based route swap' here?

emma: Logs show proxy (nginx-edge) sending FIN at ~60s of inactivity, while client heartbeat interval is 30s; when the connection drops the router immediately rehome the session to a lower-cost region (priority routing rule), client reconnects to new session id and our resume layer rejects it.

tori: that sounds like two issues: keepalive mismatch + aggressive route rehome. Can we stop rehoming on disconnects for N minutes for active sessions?

sam: workaround idea: set proxy keepalive timeout = client heartbeat + jitter (e.g. 40s) and add on-router grace window of 45s before re-routing. quick to patch?

emma: yes quick patch on router side for grace window possible. But we should also fix console telemetry — currently you can't see which route last served a session, so on-call can't tell why a client reconnected elsewhere.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for router:grace-window-patch -> staging at 09:40 UTC :rocket:

raj: note also billing telemetry shows duplicate token increments when resume fails and a fresh session spins up; ops will see doubled token charge for a single user action. that's a blocker for rolling this out without throttle change.

tori: can we short-circuit billing on failed resume attempts? i.e., don't record tokens when resume token was rejected within Xs of prior disconnect.

sam: yeah we could add resume-result tag to billing records and filter out 'resume_rejected' events from customer-facing metering until we converge on idempotent resume semantics.

emma: created an issue: https://go/repo/RED-issues/1234 — patch router grace window + proxy keepalive config + console column for "last-route". Action items:
- sam: add billing flag to ignore resume_rejected (owner)
- tori: router grace window PR (owner)
- raj: proxy timeout change rollout plan (owner)

raj: also let's add a console alert when route-change rate per-session > 1/min for a tenant. That would catch regressions.

sam: ack. I'll spec the billing flag and make it opt-in for now.

tori: putting PR up for router in 30m, will include telemetry tag so console can display recent route history.

emma: thanks all. If anyone sees new reconnect spikes ping here. :thumbsup:
